articles.title: しゃべるAIが“顔”付きに ～Google、「Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar」を発表
facts: Gemini 3.8 Live adds generated avatar video and asynchronous tool calls; provided in Gemini Enterprise.
97 languages including Japanese; SynthID applied to audio and video.
Custom avatars restricted to Google-approved companies; continuous avatar conversations currently only several minutes, not hours.

articles.title: Unity、「Meta VR Glasses」の開発サポートを開始。AIツール連携で対応を加速
facts: Unity engine support available immediately; device general availability planned for spring 2027, not already shipped.
Unity CLI workflow and AI tools in Meta SDK support preparation.
Linked official Unity release read separately: Unity 6.6+, Meta XR All-in-One SDK v207, OpenXR and editor-based interaction testing; no claim that simulator results replace device validation.

articles.title: KDDI、モルゲンロット、トークネットの3社、リテールロボットを活用した分散型データセンターの実証を開始
facts: APN connects Osaka Sakai data center and Tama network center; Point-to-Multipoint APN simulates user-site connectivity inside Tama.
GPU virtualization used for distributed robot training and remote inference.
Compares local-only, remote-only and distributed training; inference GPU placement 0km,20km+,50km+,500km+.
Experiment announcement, not published quantitative latency or energy savings; underlying company announcement Sept18 is distinguished from this Sept25 article.

articles.title: スクリプト言語「PHP」にセキュリティ更新、v8.5.11、v8.4.26、v8.3.35、v8.2.34が公開
facts: Four PHP security releases published Sept24 UTC, eleven fixes reported.
Includes HTTP wrapper cross-origin credential leak on redirects and PHP-FPM listen.allowed_clients IPv6 comparison issue.
PHP8.2 security support ends2026-12-31; patching within series does not extend lifecycle.

articles.title: 国内企業の75％が「セキュリティ疲れ」　4つの構造的な要因とは
articles.source: ITmedia エンタープライズ
facts: TD SYNNEX survey:410 respondents at Japanese companies with300+employees and multiple security products.
Four structural issues:tool overload,alert fatigue,visibility gap,staff/person dependency.
Self-reported selected sample, not a universal prevalence estimate or proof that automation reduces incidents.
